contexts.history6: current plus mean of six 2 s windows, maximum support 7 s

strategies.early: Concatenate all allowed modality features, one logistic pipeline
strategies.intermediate_pca90: Per-modality imputer, scaler and unsupervised PCA retaining 90% train variance; concatenate embeddings, logistic classifier
strategies.late_mean: Separate logistic pipeline per modality; arithmetic mean of class probabilities
strategies.late_geometric: Separate logistic pipeline per modality; normalized geometric mean of class probabilities
strategies.unimodal: Separate logistic pipeline for each allowed modality

selection: No model, weight, PCA threshold or context selected from validation or test metrics
evaluation: Same eligible rows and frozen participant split for all strategies; exploratory because test was previously inspected
